framework: Velmère Furnace V6 Institutional TradFi Audit Engine
executiveSummary: AGENT-15 has conducted an exhaustive, forensic-level audit of the Real Markets TradFi models, asset class firewalls, microstructure telemetry, and proof planes across the Velmère Furnace V6 codebase. All 20 canonical equities, commodities, FX pairs, and ETFs (NVDA, AAPL, MSFT, TSLA, AMZN, GOOGL, META, BRK.B, JPM, V, WMT, SPY, QQQ, TLT, GC=F, SI=F, CL=F, EURUSD=X, USDJPY=X, ^TNX) have been audited against strict domain isolation rules, asset-specific microstructure models (dark pool midpoint crossing, block trade clustering, Kyle's Lambda price impact, institutional order flow, and session statuses), and anti-synthetic data uniqueness requirements. Zero EVM bytecode, Solidity AST metadata, or AMM sandwich attack vectors exist within TradFi records. All 20 canonical instruments possess unique, non-repeating cryptographic provenance seals, distinct clearing mechanics, and individual statutory disclosures.

enforcedBoundaries.rule: Strictly prohibited for TradFi asset classes (equity, commodity, fx, index). Blocked by assertAssetCanAccessAnalyzer throwing AssetFirewallViolationError.
Compiler versions set to 'N/A (Traditional Equity / Risk Factor Models)' or 'N/A (Traditional Financial Instrument)'. No pragma or solc metadata present.
No uniswap, sushiswap, or AMM constant product pool invariants. Replaced by Continuous Double Auction Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) and NBBO spreads.
No flash loan borrow paths. Replaced by NSCC/DTCC central counterparty novation and clearinghouse margin requirements.
No Chainlink or TWAP oracle dependencies. Pricing sourced directly from Consolidated Tape Association (CTA), UTP, or primary exchange SIP feeds.
Zero storage slot collision scans. Replaced by Central Securities Depository Reconciliation (DTC/Euroclear/Fedwire) and T+1 delivery ledgers.

darkPoolMidpointCrossing.architecture: FINRA Alternative Trading Systems (ATS) & Trade Reporting Facility (TRF) aggregation
mechanics: Asset-specific modeled ATS volume shares (e.g. AAPL 38.4%, NVDA 44.7%, SPY 32.1%, MSFT 39.2%) replacing banned universal static 41.2%
Midpoint peg execution without pre-trade lit display under SEC Rule 606 transparency framework
Automated detection of adverse selection and information leakage vectors in unlit pools

blockTradeClustering.architecture: Institutional Whale Watch & Block Trade Filter (> $1,000,000 threshold)
mechanics: Dynamic translation of whale telemetry to institutional venues (Citadel Darkpool, Jane Street Liquidity, Virtu Financial, Morgan Stanley Prime Brokerage, Fedwire Custody)
SEC Form 13F and Form N-PORT passive institutional accumulation tracking (Vanguard, BlackRock, State Street)
SEC Rule 10b5-1 pre-scheduled insider transaction monitoring

institutionalOrderFlow.architecture: Regulated Central Limit Order Book (CLOB) & Multi-Venue Quorum
mechanics: Kyle's Lambda price impact model using square-root participation law: Impact = Y * sigma * sqrt(Notional / ADV) * 10,000
Exchange venue weighting: NASDAQ TotalView ITCH (38%), NYSE Integrated Feed (30%), Cboe BZX Pitch L2 (18%), IEX (8%), ATS Midpoint (6%)
Options dealer gamma imbalances and OpEx delta-hedging flow monitoring for high-beta instruments (NVDA, TSLA)

sessionStatusAndCircuitBreakers.architecture: National Market System (NMS) Trading Halts & Clearing Hours
mechanics: Dynamic Limit-Up / Limit-Down (LULD) price bands enforced under SEC Reg NMS
SEC Rule 201 Short Sale Alternative Uptick rule circuit breaker
Market-Wide Circuit Breakers (MWCB Level 1: 7%, Level 2: 13%, Level 3: 20% halt on S&P 500 benchmark)
Clearing cycle enforcement: DTCC/NSCC T+1 Continuous Net Settlement, CME SPAN dynamic margin, BOJ-NET/Fedwire PvP via CLS Bank
